context: You have just defeated the dragon Ansur and clicked the Helm of Balduran to claim it; the helm is revealed to be filled with Ansur’s spirit. Wyll, nearby, recognizes the artifact as Balduran’s helm and reacts in awe. Off‑screen, Ansur’s spirit manifests as a draconic essence that now infuses the item and will grant you power for as long as you wear it. This is an immediate post‑combat reward moment—how the spirit behaves afterward (quietly empowering you, speaking through you, or influencing later companion reactions or epilogue beats) can vary, but those outcomes are not shown here.
